Production SEO & Technical QA Audit Plan:
1. Create and execute an automated HTTP & JSON-LD audit script against key canonical and redirected URLs.
2. Verify /robots.txt and /sitemap.xml index feeds for 100% canonical URL inclusion.
3. Automatically repair any identified broken internal links or metadata gaps.
4. Verify TypeScript and ESLint build status.
5. Provide a comprehensive 6-part audit summary report.
